comparison: identical depth, attention placement, and read count with a varying number of shared key-value caches

control.note: byte-identical architecture to the source; not retrained

findings: the cost of sharing is smooth and graded, not a cliff: every arm is inside the 0.00965-nat seed range against the five-cache control
each independent cache converted to a query-only reader costs roughly 0.002 nats, between 0.00196 and 0.00274 across the three arms
one and two caches are indistinguishable at 0.000379 nats, so one cache dominates two at half the resident state
all eleven validation sources are worse than the control for every arm
the endpoint reaches a 4.94x resident state reduction at 128K for a 0.007852-nat aggregate cost that one seed cannot resolve
a second writer at the mid-depth integration point recovers nothing, refuting the pre-registered shallow-writer explanation
throughput comparisons across back-to-back runs on this card are not thermally controlled and are not claimed
not_yet_measured: distractor-controlled structured retrieval and held-out template gates
